rules.user_facing_meaning: Monthly business income must meet the minimum for your applicant type.
rules.inline_support: Use your typical monthly business revenue average before taxes.

rules.user_facing_meaning: You must be able to document business income for the required lookback period.
rules.inline_support: Only months you can document count.
This means your business will not earn revenue from Costa Rica–based clients or conduct commercial activity in Costa Rica while you are there.

rules.user_facing_meaning: A valid passport is required at the time of application.
rules.inline_support: Your passport must be valid when you apply.

rules.user_facing_meaning: You must have qualifying health insurance or commit to obtaining it.
rules.inline_support: Insurance must cover your stay in Costa Rica.

rules.user_facing_meaning: Nationality must permit lawful entry under Costa Rica’s visa regime.
Approval is subject to DGME security and background review.
rules.inline_support: A yes answer does not mean automatic denial.
